name: Decrease
momentumNotes: Decrease can be medicine; reducing excess frees attention for what is sincere.
theme: Decrease removes excess so sincerity can be felt. Less is not deprivation when it returns attention to what matters.
basicInterpretation: Offer something unnecessary back to the world. A smaller gesture made with truth can carry more life than an impressive display.
reflectionPrompt: What could you release to become more sincere?

reversed.theme: Flipped upside down, Decrease becomes Hexagram 42, Increase. This other side brings in the atmosphere of growth, generosity, blessing, asking how the situation may look from another threshold.
reversed.reflection: Let Increase widen the reading rather than replace it. Consider what another person, timing, or hidden part of you might see when the pattern is viewed from the far side.
reversed.applicationPrompt: Visualize your question from the far side, as if another person or your future self is looking back through Increase. Notice where growth, generosity, blessing and a growing, moving movement reveal needs, timing, or motives that the first view may miss.

opposite.theme: The contrast to Decrease is Hexagram 31, Influence. Where the primary pattern emphasizes simplification, sacrifice, sincerity, this complementary field points toward attraction, response, sensitivity.
opposite.reflection: This is not the main movement of the reading, but it shows what balances or challenges it. It can also highlight hidden causes or contrasting forces at play. Notice where Influence names the medicine, shadow, or unchosen path beside the situation.
opposite.applicationPrompt: Visualize Influence as the contrasting color laid beside Decrease. Ask what hidden cause, missing medicine, or opposing pressure is suggested by attraction, response, sensitivity, especially where the situation carries a supportive, intimate tone.
